description: Run any Summer operation by name (from summer_search) with its input. Engine operations run here; cloud ones run on Summer's server with the same approvals: money, publishing and live changes answer needs_approval with a link. 3.x tool names work too.

dryRun.description: Check and describe the call without doing it.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key for writes; reuse it only to retry the identical call.

input.description: The operation's input, matching the schema summer_search returned.

op.description: The operation name, e.g. engine.add_node or pricing.set_base (or a 3.x tool name).

name: summer_call
